title: Signal: Content-Security-Policy frame-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
scope: One response whose Content-Security-Policy carries an explicit frame-src directive whose source list contains the `http:` scheme token.
limitations: One header value and one directive. The rule reports the scheme token in frame-src only; when frame-src is absent the default-src fallback decides, and other rules report that case. It cannot tell whether the plaintext origin is reachable from the browser that receives the policy.
fpNotes: A deployment that deliberately proxies a legacy plaintext origin is still flagged; the finding is the scheme in the policy, not proof that the origin answers the browser.
